What you need and how to connect

Radvela receives FM and DAB+ directly, with no internet stream. You need:

1. An RTL-SDR USB dongle (RTL2832U).
2. A USB OTG adapter, if your device has no full-size USB port.
3. An antenna; about 33 cm vertical for DAB+, 75 cm for FM.

Plug in the dongle, choose ALWAYS in the permission window, then run AUTO SCAN from the menu. Your device must support USB host mode, and DAB+ needs local coverage.

The music player needs no dongle: it plays songs from this device, an SD card or a USB drive. Open MUSIC to choose a source, and use + for a folder that is not listed.
What the app sends and stores

Radvela has no account, advertising or analytics. Radio reception works offline and your stations stay on this device.

If station logos are on (Settings), station names are sent to radio-browser.info to find logos; that service also sees your IP address, as any website does. Turn this off in Settings. Logo images may also be downloaded from a station's own website.

Recordings are saved only to your device.
